scientific_integrity: Analytical proofs supply arbitrary-size claims; exact finite enumeration independently corroborates them. Existing equilibria criterion and known limiting values are explicitly attributed; bibliographic equivalences outside inspected sources remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Two types, complete occupation, nonlocal bilateral swaps, binary utility or the exact normalized single-peak Lambda=1/2 case, n>=3 and 1<=b<=r. No assertion for jump games, other utility peaks, or rotational quotient counts; computational enumeration covers n<=16 only. Balanced 4/3 and 3-to-1 population limit two are prior asymptotic results.
title: Exact finite imbalance law and equilibrium welfare census for binary Schelling swaps on cycles
